faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-14: the one-unit window is read on the complete unit at minute 30; a monotonic partial response at minute 15, with no floor there
faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-15: the windows are regions; their centres are not targets
faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-16: the feasible joint region is accepted as a structural result, not as a calibration
faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-17: the rate interval is part of a joint development region only with its compatible scale; never a clinically measured rate, never selected alone
faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-18: the old CANDIDATE scale band may be marked superseded if it is only a candidate analysis band
faculty_decisions_applied.FD-RATE-20: a new blinded human review of FR-B, FR-C, FR-E and FR-G before any adoption

dominant_constraints.at_fast_rates: R: the frozen evaluator can no longer READ FD-BLD-06 in 57m
dominant_constraints.at_large_scales: B: the +8 mmHg floor of the complete unit in 57m
dominant_constraints.at_small_scales: C: the 35 % ceiling of the slow-crystalloid share, together with the closed region's floor (K) and the fast edge of the untreated window (A)
never_binding_inside_the_region: the +18 mmHg ceiling of one unit
the 15 % floor of the slow-crystalloid share
the upper bounds of the closed crystalloid region

fragile_corners.where: smallest scale, fastest admitted untreated course, least-retaining closed-region kernel
fragile_corners.why_fragile: three constraints meet: the share ceiling (C), the closed region's floor (K) and the fast edge of the untreated window (A)

fragile_corners.where: largest scale, slowest admitted untreated course
fragile_corners.why_fragile: the complete unit is exactly at its +8 mmHg floor in 57m, at the slow edge of the untreated window

interior.reading: the region is NARROW: its most interior point keeps about an eighth of each window; the untreated window is itself under a tenth of c wide

geometry.normalisation: each margin is the distance to the nearest bound of its own constraint over the width of that constraint's window (A: the c window; B: 10 mmHg; C: 20 percentage points; K: each closed-region envelope; R: the rate span of the verified region)

robust_floor.meaning: 5 % of a window: 0.5 mmHg of the one-unit window (half of a displayed mmHg), one percentage point of the slow-crystalloid window
robust_floor.status: an operational convention of this analysis, not a faculty decision

old_scale_band.canonical_provenance: the registry's own reason is that the default 'keeps the legacy slope at position 0.5' (FD-P3-61): a legacy reconstruction, not clinical evidence

introduced.subject: P2F-2..11: GI truth, candidate bands, registry, frozen rules, A9, dry run
introduced.what_the_commit_says: the Level-2 registry (CANDIDATE 47, DEFAULT_UNMAPPED 4, SYNTHETIC_ONLY 2, FACULTY_APPROVED 0)

old_scale_band.name: PURE_CANDIDATE_ANALYSIS_BAND
old_scale_band.registry_rationale: scale of the saturating preload curve; the default keeps the legacy slope at position 0.5. Read in V units: with kappa (P2I-2T) only the ratio scale / kappa is identifiable, so it is never decided alone: FD-08, FD-14, FD-15 and FD-BLD-02..04 all constrain the same scale / kappa (P2I-2U)

stronger_status_search_basis.what_the_manual_audit_read: the Decision File rows that name the scale, clinical_core.blood_constraints and the runtime layer's validators

supersession.scope: the current joint analysis only: the band stops being read as the domain of the joint region
supersession.why_the_registry_is_not_edited: it lives in clinical_core, whose certified digest covers every source; carrying the mark there needs a certified successor of the core

old_scale_band.what_the_faculty_did_approve: one POINT (833.33 mL-eq, with the six other values of gi_pressure_committed) for the development pressure experiment only (FD-P3-42): 'approving the point is not approving the clinical truth of each magnitude'; never the band

who_reads_the_band.the calibration sweep and the decision p: exploration grids inside the band; they select nothing

the certified core's own haemorrhage pro.note: explored, never approved: the certified core already ran scales up to twice the band's top

the frozen blood evaluator.note: it READS its haemoglobin constraints at one fixed state whose scale is the band's top; a reading convention, not a constraint on the scale, and not changed by this audit

who_reads_the_band.the shadow region witnesses of Phase 3 (: the corners of the declared region, used as development shadow witnesses; unchanged

coordinates.bleed_rate: never a coordinate: always c x scale (FD-RATE-17)
coordinates.c: bleed rate / preload scale, per minute
coordinates.kernel: (e, s, tau) of the crystalloid retention kernel

kernel_family_used.limit: the family is one curve through the closed region (the one most favourable to C at each depth); other kernels of the same depth retain more and are compatible on a smaller part of (c, scale)
kernel_family_used.what: for each depth d in the closed region, the least-retaining kernel whose four behaviours are at least d of their window from both bounds

A_untreated.source: the frozen U-OUT faculty envelopes, both cases

B_one_unit.closed_form: SBP rise = SBP_arrival x (1 - f)(1 - exp(-kappa x 300 / scale)) / f
B_one_unit.source: FD-RATE-09 as clarified by FD-RATE-14: the complete unit, +8 .. +18 mmHg at minute 30, both cases

C_slow_crystalloid.closed_form: share = 1 - (exp(d_t) - 1) / (exp(d_u) - 1), with d_u the untreated effective-volume deficit at minute 60 over the scale and d_t = d_u - retained_60(kernel) / scale; to first order share = retained_60 / (volume lost in 60 min)
C_slow_crystalloid.couples: all three coordinates: it is why the ranges cannot be read apart

K_closed_crystalloid_region.rule: the kernel's Rpeak, R30, R60 and R120 on a 1 L / 20 min bag inside the closed region

R_existing_constraints.rule: every existing frozen constraint readable and met: in practice c x scale <= the readability limit

projections_are_not_ranges.warning: a rate from one end with a scale from the other is OUTSIDE the region: only c x scale pairs inside A are points

what_it_is: The joint GI rate / pressure development region as an explicit object, its margins, three development test witnesses and their candidate trajectories for a blinded human re-review. MODEL_ANALYSIS: nothing is approved, no point is a calibration, and nothing here is clinical validation.
